entries.def: in the midland or interior , Lat. mediterraneus, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

1. a going up, mounting on horseback, (Xenophon Historicus):—; πᾶσα ἄμβασις = πάντες ἀναβάται, all the horsemen , (Sophocles Tragicus) 
2. an expedition up from the coast into Central Asia, as that of the younger Cyrus, (Xenophon Historicus) 
3. a way up, ascent of a tower or mountain, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)
to raise or lift up, carry , (Lucian) (ML)
one mounted , of Pentheus in the tree, (Euripides): a horseman, rider , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)
to shoot up, grow up again , of Plants, (Plato Philosophus); of a city, (Herdotus Historicus); of misfortunes, to spring up, be rank , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)
to boil well, seethe , with accusative, (Aristophanes Comicus); absolute, ἀναβράττετ᾽, ἐξοπτᾶτε (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

1. to yoke again , ἀναζευγνύναι τὸν στρατόν to move off the army, (Herdotus Historicus); ἀν. τὸ στρατόπεδον to break up the camp, (Herdotus Historicus); ἀν. τὰς νῆας to move Them back, (Herdotus Historicus) 
2. absolute to break up, shift one's quarters , (Thucydides) (ML)
